research_goal: every 10 minutes reconstruct the current hydraulic state from sparse causal sensing, estimate how candidate actions of 109 writable facilities change future system-wide cumulative TFV, conservatively decide whether the best predicted action beats HOLD, execute only the first 10-minute target, and repeat

core_pipeline.step1: reconstruct the current full-network hydraulic state from sparse causal observations so online control does not require a fresh full SWMM state simulation
core_pipeline.step2: learn state-conditioned pairwise action value directly: causal current state + causal rainfall forecast + complete reference sequence + complete candidate 109-facility sequence -> delta TFV
core_pipeline.selection: use a Development-calibrated one-sided selected-action residual margin to admit an action only when predicted delta TFV plus margin remains below HOLD zero
core_pipeline.step3: after selection calibration is supported, minimize Step2 predicted delta TFV over 12 x 109 bounded continuous control variables, apply the calibrated HOLD guard, execute the first 10-minute target, then re-observe
core_pipeline.swmm: authoritative offline label generator and final evaluation truth; not the online candidate evaluator

time_contract.terminal_tail: hold final H120 target through H360

action_contract.engineering_decoder: reuse bounded differentiable Step3 decoder with per-facility min/max and max-delta

step2_current.primary_target: authoritative exact SWMM delta TFV relative to the same-prefix reference action
step2_current.model: shared pairwise sequence-value encoder: V(candidate)-V(reference), decomposed into 109 facility value differences plus one multi-actuator interaction value difference
step2_current.reference_representation: encode the complete H360 reference and candidate sequences with the same network; never reduce the reference to only its first setting
step2_current.reference_families: D2 base-action, D3 HOLD and D4 causal Sparse-RBC anchor are all valid Development pairwise references; future Step3 uses HOLD
step2_current.antisymmetry_contract: swapping candidate and reference negates predicted delta TFV exactly under the same causal prefix
step2_current.single_actuator_supervision: same-prefix D2/D3/D4 single-facility counterfactuals teach facility main-value differences
step2_current.joint_supervision: multi-facility D3/D4 counterfactuals teach only the interaction value difference after main-effect training
step2_current.state_conditioning: causal Step1 reconstructed state, including each facility upstream/downstream local state plus a compact global hydraulic context
step2_current.temporal_action_encoding: complete reference and candidate H360 sequences are each compressed to 36 ten-minute blocks so delayed and reference-family effects remain learnable
step2_current.zero_action_contract: candidate equals reference -> predicted delta TFV exactly zero
step2_current.single_action_interaction_contract: interaction residual exactly zero when fewer than two facilities change
step2_current.training_loss: continuous normalized exact delta-TFV regression plus within-group pairwise ordering; the historical 1-percent practical-effect threshold is reporting-only and never converts labels to zero
step2_current.interaction_stage: freeze learned facility/context representation and fit joint interaction value difference from multi-actuator candidates
step2_current.development_profile: smoke remains a small deterministic signal check; dev uses all admitted existing Development groups: 112 D2 FIT, 112 D3 FIT, 33 D4 FIT, 32 D2 holdout, 32 D3 holdout and all 15 D4 AUDIT groups
step2_current.full_dev_interpretation: V2 preserves useful held-out D2/D3 ordering and substantially improves D4 ranking, but raw argmin selection remains over-eager: all split hold_selected_fraction values are zero, D4 FIT contains oracle-HOLD groups that are always acted on, and D4 selected true delta TFV is approximately neutral/slightly harmful on average
step2_current.gradient_role: automatic differentiation through direct value model is only an online solver mechanism

selection_current.checkpoint_input: frozen full-DEV Direct-TFV V2 checkpoint; no model retraining
selection_current.calibration_source: existing D3 HOLD-reference internal holdout only, split again by rainfall group into disjoint selection-calibration and selection-audit subsets
selection_current.d4_role: D4 FIT and D4 AUDIT are stress evaluations for the guard; D4 AUDIT never fits the margin
selection_current.nonconformity: selected-action residual = authoritative true delta TFV minus predicted delta TFV for raw action-selected calibration groups
selection_current.guard: admit the model-best action only when predicted delta TFV + calibrated one-sided margin < 0; otherwise HOLD
selection_current.reason_not_formal: Development calibration does not assume exchangeability across the D3-to-D4 reference/operating-region shift and is not Policy Lock evidence

data_roles.D0: baseline hydraulic-state/flood opportunity context; not direct facility attribution
data_roles.D1: state/action coverage; not direct facility credit assignment
data_roles.D3: HOLD-reference temporal single-facility supervision plus multi-facility interaction supervision; its model holdout is the only current HOLD-reference source suitable for no-new-SWMM selection calibration
data_roles.D4_FIT: causal Sparse-RBC-reference first-move/local-operating-region supervision and Development stress evaluation
data_roles.D4_AUDIT: causal Sparse-RBC-reference Development evaluation only; excluded from training, target-scale fitting and selection-margin fitting
data_roles.D5: optional later solver-sensitivity diagnostic, not a prerequisite for learning TFV value

step3_current.objective: predicted delta TFV relative to HOLD
step3_current.optimizer: bounded L-BFGS-B through the direct differentiable value model
step3_current.fallback: HOLD when no finite predicted TFV improvement exceeding the configured minimum margin is found
step3_current.promotion_requires: first show that the no-retrain selection guard improves selected authoritative delta TFV and harmful-action rate on a disjoint D3 HOLD-reference audit and D4 Development stress tests without collapsing all actions to HOLD

legacy_v128.status: retained for ablation/history, not the canonical current Step2
legacy_v128.reason: Development B0 ran successfully but TFV candidate ordering remained near-random or worse on D2/D3/D4, while authoritative facility diagnostics confirmed physical TFV control signal

promotion_rule: do not change the V2 ranking architecture first. Calibrate and audit HOLD/action selection on the frozen full-DEV checkpoint. Only if a conservative margin cannot make selected true delta TFV non-harmful without collapsing action rate should the project generate a small targeted HOLD-reference first-move SWMM panel or modify the selection loss.
